style_prompt: Original landscape 3:2 picture-book illustration; delicate graphite pencil linework, soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture on warm ivory paper, muted natural colors, no 3D. No text, signs, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
scene_prompt: Meaning: fickle loyalties, repeatedly changing sides to suit oneself (negative). Modern school club election scene: one student in the center turns toward two rival club groups, secretly switching a plain colored team ribbon from one wrist to the other while smiling ingratiatingly at whichever group currently offers a prize. The two groups look disappointed and distrustful as they notice the repeated disloyalty. Show a single clear moment, only three or four students, no duplicated figures, no split panels. Make the self-serving change of allegiance visible, not normal exploration or friendly cooperation. Natural anatomy, hands and ribbon contact, grounded feet, coherent school courtyard.
alt: 學生偷偷更換手腕上的隊伍色帶，兩邊社團同學發現後都露出失望神情。
